verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms MoonPay serves a structured llms.txt at dev.moonpay.com (HTTP 200, "# MoonPay Developer Docs" index). The docs also include a dedicated "using agents" page describing a docs MCP server that lets agents search and retrieve content, and pages are available as .md for agent consumption. missing for 10: independent or community hands-on reports of agents successfully consuming these docs, and evidence of an llms-full.txt or similarly complete agent-oriented bundle.
